title: The Bugs in the Bins
lines: Ben and Meg got ten tin bins.
"Bugs can nap in the bins," said Ben.
Meg dug and got bugs and buds.
The bugs did not nap. The bugs did dig!
Ten bugs got up and got in the beds!
Mom and Dad did not nap.
Ben and Meg set the bugs in the mud.

questions.ask: What did Ben and Meg put the bugs in?
questions.listenFor: Ten tin bins. The story says it. If your child is unsure, point to the word bins and read that line again.

questions.ask: Why did Mom and Dad not get a nap?
questions.listenFor: Because the bugs got out and got in the beds. Listen for the bugs in the beds - that is the problem in the story.

questions.ask: Do you think the mud was a good spot for the bugs? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Any answer is fine. You are listening for a reason - bugs dig in mud, or the bins were never going to hold them.
